lines.text: Heman the Ezrahite cries out to the LORD day and night and asks Him to incline His ear.
Heman's life draws near to Sheol, and he says the LORD has laid him in the lowest Pit.
Heman says the LORD's waves have submerged him and that the LORD has made him repulsive to his friends.
Heman spreads out his hands to the LORD daily and asks about His faithfulness in Abaddon.
Heman says he has been afflicted since his youth, and the LORD's terrors enclose him like water on every side.
